verses.t: About what are they asking one another
verses.pickthall: Whereof do they question one another
verses.yusufAli: Concerning what are they disputing
verses.rodwell: Of what ask they of one another
verses.sale: Concerning what do the unbelievers ask questions of one another

verses.t: About the great news
verses.pickthall: (It is) of the awful tidings
verses.yusufAli: Concerning the Great News
verses.rodwell: Of the great NEWS
verses.sale: Concerning the great news of the resurrection

verses.t: That over which they are in disagreement
verses.pickthall: Concerning which they are in disagreement
verses.yusufAli: About which they cannot agree
verses.rodwell: The theme of their disputes
verses.sale: about which they disagree

verses.t: No! They are going to know
verses.pickthall: Nay, but they will come to know
verses.yusufAli: Verily, they shall soon (come to) know
verses.rodwell: Nay! they shall certainly knows its truth
verses.sale: Assuredly they shall hereafter know the truth thereof

verses.t: Then, no! They are going to know
verses.pickthall: Nay, again, but they will come to know
verses.yusufAli: Verily, verily they shall soon (come to) know
verses.rodwell: Again. Nay! they shall certainly know it
verses.sale: Again, assuredly they shall hereafter know the truth thereof

verses.t: Have We not made the earth a resting place
verses.pickthall: Have We not made the earth an expanse
verses.yusufAli: Have We not made the earth as a wide expanse
verses.rodwell: Have we not made the Earth a couch
verses.sale: Have We not made the earth for a bed

verses.t: And the mountains as stakes
verses.pickthall: And the high hills bulwarks
verses.yusufAli: And the mountains as pegs
verses.rodwell: And the mountains its tent-stakes
verses.sale: and the mountains for stakes to fix the same

verses.t: And We created you in pairs
verses.pickthall: And We have created you in pairs
verses.yusufAli: And (have We not) created you in pairs
verses.rodwell: We have created you of two sexes
verses.sale: And have We not created you of two sexes

verses.t: And made your sleep [a means for] rest
verses.pickthall: And have appointed your sleep for repose
verses.yusufAli: And made your sleep for rest
verses.rodwell: And ordained your sleep for rest
verses.sale: and appointed your sleep for rest

verses.t: And made the night as clothing
verses.pickthall: And have appointed the night as a cloak
verses.yusufAli: And made the night as a covering
verses.rodwell: And ordained the night as a mantle
verses.sale: and made the night a garment to cover you

verses.t: And made the day for livelihood
verses.pickthall: And have appointed the day for livelihood
verses.yusufAli: And made the day as a means of subsistence
verses.rodwell: And ordained the day for gaining livelihood
verses.sale: and destined the day to the gaining your livelihood

verses.t: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
verses.pickthall: And We have built above you seven strong (heavens)
verses.yusufAli: And (have We not) built over you the seven firmaments
verses.rodwell: And built above you seven solid heavens
verses.sale: and built over you seven solid heavens

verses.t: And made [therein] a burning lamp
verses.pickthall: And have appointed a dazzling lamp
verses.yusufAli: And placed (therein) a Light of Splendour
verses.rodwell: And placed therein a burning lamp
verses.sale: and placed therein a burning lamp

verses.t: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water
verses.pickthall: And have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water
verses.yusufAli: And do We not send down from the clouds water in abundance
verses.rodwell: And we send down water in abundance from the rain-clouds
verses.sale: And do We not send down from the clouds pressing forth rain, water pouring down in abundance

verses.t: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
verses.pickthall: Thereby to produce grain and plant
verses.yusufAli: That We may produce therewith corn and vegetables
verses.rodwell: That we may bring forth by it corn and herbs
verses.sale: that We may thereby produce corn, and herbs

verses.t: And gardens of entwined growth
verses.pickthall: And gardens of thick foliage
verses.yusufAli: And gardens of luxurious growth
verses.rodwell: And gardens thick with trees
verses.sale: and gardens planted thick with trees

verses.t: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time
verses.pickthall: Lo! the Day of Decision is a fixed time
verses.yusufAli: Verily the Day of Sorting out is a thing appointed
verses.rodwell: Lo! the day of Severance is fixed
verses.sale: Verily the day of separation is a fixed period

verses.t: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
verses.pickthall: A day when the trumpet is blown and ye come in multitudes
verses.yusufAli: The Day that the Trumpet shall be sounded, and ye shall come forth in crowds
verses.rodwell: The day when there shall be a blast on the trumpet, and ye shall come in crowds
verses.sale: The day whereon the trumpet shall sound, and ye shall come in troops to judgment

verses.t: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
verses.pickthall: And the heaven is opened and becometh as gates
verses.yusufAli: And the heavens shall be opened as if there were doors
verses.rodwell: And the heaven shall be opened and be full of portals
verses.sale: and the heaven shall be opened, and shall be full of gates for the angels to pass through

verses.t: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage
verses.pickthall: And the hills are set in motion and become as a mirage
verses.yusufAli: And the mountains shall vanish, as if they were a mirage
verses.rodwell: And the mountains shall be set in motion, and melt into thin vapour
verses.sale: and the mountains shall pass away, and become as a vapour

verses.t: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
verses.pickthall: Lo! hell lurketh in ambush
verses.yusufAli: Truly Hell is as a place of ambush
verses.rodwell: Hell truly shall be a place of snares
verses.sale: verily hell shall be a place of ambush

verses.t: For the transgressors, a place of return
verses.pickthall: A home for the rebellious
verses.yusufAli: For the transgressors a place of destination
verses.rodwell: The home of transgressors
verses.sale: a receptacle for the transgressors

verses.t: In which they will remain for ages [unending]
verses.pickthall: They will abide therein for ages
verses.yusufAli: They will dwell therein for ages
verses.rodwell: To abide therein ages
verses.sale: who shall remain therein for ages

verses.t: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink
verses.pickthall: Therein taste they neither coolness nor (any) drink
verses.yusufAli: Nothing cool shall they taste therein, nor any drink
verses.rodwell: No coolness shall they taste therein nor any drink
verses.sale: They shall not taste any refreshment therein, or any drink

verses.t: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence
verses.pickthall: Save boiling water and a paralysing cold
verses.yusufAli: Save a boiling fluid and a fluid, dark, murky, intensely cold
verses.rodwell: Save boiling water and running sores
verses.sale: except boiling water, and filthy corruption

verses.t: An appropriate recompense
verses.pickthall: Reward proportioned (to their evil deeds)
verses.yusufAli: A fitting recompense (for them)
verses.rodwell: Meet recompense
verses.sale: A fit recompense for their deeds

verses.t: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
verses.pickthall: For lo! they looked not for a reckoning
verses.yusufAli: For that they used not to fear any account (for their deeds)
verses.rodwell: For they looked not forward to their account
verses.sale: For they hoped that they should not be brought to an account

verses.t: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial
verses.pickthall: They called Our revelations false with strong denial
verses.yusufAli: But they (impudently) treated Our Signs as false
verses.rodwell: And they gave the lie to our signs, charging them with falsehood
verses.sale: and they disbelieved our signs, accusing them of falsehood

verses.t: But all things We have enumerated in writing
verses.pickthall: Everything have We recorded in a Book
verses.yusufAli: And all things have We preserved on record
verses.rodwell: But we noted and wrote down all
verses.sale: But every thing have We computed, and written down

verses.t: So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment
verses.pickthall: So taste (of that which ye have earned). No increase do We give you save of torment
verses.yusufAli: So taste ye (the fruits of your deeds); for no increase shall We grant you, except in Punishment
verses.rodwell: Taste this then: and we will give you increase of nought but torment
verses.sale: Taste, therefore: We will not add unto you any other than torment

verses.t: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment
verses.pickthall: Lo! for the duteous is achievement
verses.yusufAli: Verily for the Righteous there will be a fulfilment of (the heart's) desires
verses.rodwell: But, for the God-fearing is a blissful abode
verses.sale: But for the pious is prepared a place of bliss

verses.t: Gardens and grapevines
verses.pickthall: Gardens enclosed and vineyards
verses.yusufAli: Gardens enclosed, and grapevines
verses.rodwell: Enclosed gardens and vineyards
verses.sale: Gardens planted with trees, and vineyards

verses.t: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age
verses.pickthall: And voluptuous women of equal age
verses.yusufAli: And voluptuous women of equal age
verses.rodwell: And damsels with swelling breasts, their peers in age
verses.sale: and damsels with swelling breasts, of equal age with themselves

verses.t: And a full cup
verses.pickthall: And a full cup
verses.yusufAli: And a cup full (to the brim)
verses.rodwell: And a full cup
verses.sale: and a full cup

verses.t: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood
verses.pickthall: There hear they never vain discourse, nor lying
verses.yusufAli: No vanity shall they hear therein, nor Untruth
verses.rodwell: There shall they hear no vain discourse nor any falsehood
verses.sale: They shall hear no vain discourse there, nor any falsehood

verses.t: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account
verses.pickthall: Requital from thy Lord - a gift in payment
verses.yusufAli: Recompense from thy Lord, a gift, (amply) sufficient
verses.rodwell: A recompense from thy Lord-sufficing gift
verses.sale: This shall be their recompense from thy Lord; a gift fully sufficient

verses.t: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech
verses.pickthall: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and (all) that is between them, the Beneficent; with Whom none can converse
verses.yusufAli: (From) the Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all between, (Allah) Most Gracious: None shall have power to argue with Him
verses.rodwell: Lord of the heavens and of the earth, and of all that between them lieth - the God of Mercy! But not a word shall they obtain from Him
verses.sale: From the Lord of heaven and earth, and of whatever is between them; the Merciful. The inhabitants of heaven or of earth shall not dare to demand audience of Him

verses.t: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct
verses.pickthall: On the day when the angels and the Spirit stand arrayed, they speak not, saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth and who speaketh right
verses.yusufAli: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand forth in ranks, none shall speak except any who is permitted by (Allah) Most Gracious, and He will say what is right
verses.rodwell: On the day whereon the Spirit and the Angels shall be ranged in order, they shall not speak: save he whom the God of Mercy shall permit, and who shall say that which is right
verses.sale: The day whereon the spirit Gabriel, and the other angels shall stand in order, they shall not speak in behalf of themselves or others, except he only to whom the Merciful shall grant permission, and who shall say that which is right

verses.t: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return
verses.pickthall: That is the True Day. So whoso will should seek recourse unto his Lord
verses.yusufAli: That Day will be the sure Reality: Therefore, whoso will, let him take a (straight) return to his Lord
verses.rodwell: This is the sure day. Whoso then will, let him take the path of return to his Lord
verses.sale: This is the infallible day. Whoso, therefore, willeth, let him return unto his Lord

verses.t: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust
verses.pickthall: Lo! We warn you of a doom at hand, a day whereon a man will look on that which his own hands have sent before, and the disbeliever will cry: "Would that I were dust
verses.yusufAli: Verily, We have warned you of a Penalty near, the Day when man will see (the deeds) which his hands have sent forth, and the Unbeliever will say, "Woe unto me! Would that I were (metre) dust
verses.rodwell: Verily, we warn you of a chastisement close at hand: The day on which a man shall see the deeds which his hands have sent before him; and when the unbeliever shall say, "Oh! would I were dust
verses.sale: Verily We threaten you with a punishment nigh at hand: The day whereon a man shall behold the good or evil deeds which his hands have sent before him; and the unbeliever shall say, would to God I were dust
